stem: Sticky-card counts fall after an intervention, but direct crop signs continue appearing and affected plants are spreading into new zones. What should Technician II do?
choices: Declare the intervention successful because trap counts fell
Integrate trap placement, direct crop evidence, sampling consistency, and spatial spread; reopen the working diagnosis or follow-up plan if the evidence conflicts
Ignore direct signs because traps are quantitative
rationale: A single indicator cannot establish success when other comparable evidence conflicts. Technician II should integrate multiple evidence streams and escalate/reopen the diagnosis within role boundaries.
